judged_text: The slug condition was silently inverted from `!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug }` to `IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {}` — an unrelated behavior change smuggled into a destinationCalendar PR with no acceptance. With IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED=false, Organization.create runs without the required unique slug and the insert fails, breaking organization creation entirely; with it true, unverified organizations immediately occupy their slug, bypassing the requestedSlug verification flow the adjacent line (153) still implements.
